description: Represents a historical record of a change made to a business rule. Each time a rule is created, updated, or deleted, a history entry is recorded capturing the state of the rule at that point in time, who made the change, and what type of change it was. This provides a full audit trail for business rule management.

uid.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the history record (e.g., "hist-a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"). Assigned automatically by the system.

rule_uid.description: The UID of the business rule this history entry belongs to (e.g., "br-a1b2c3d4-5678-90ef-ghij-klmnopqrstuv"). Links back to the original business rule.

business_uid.description: The unique identifier (UID) of the business that owns the rule (e.g., "biz-1234abcd-5678-90ef-ghij-klmnopqrstuv").

content.description: The content of the rule at the time of the change (e.g., "Always use a friendly and professional tone when communicating with clients"). This captures the exact state of the rule content when the history entry was recorded.

source.description:
Indicates whether the change was made by the AI system or by a user (staff member).

* `system` - The change was made automatically by the AI system.
* `user` - The change was made manually by a staff member.

action.description:
The type of change that was made to the business rule.

* `created` - The rule was newly created.
* `updated` - The rule's content, category, status, or other fields were modified.
* `deleted` - The rule was removed.

changed_by_staff_uid.description: The UID of the staff member who made the change (e.g., "stf-9876wxyz-5432-10ab-cdef-ghijklmnopqr"). Will be null if the change was made by the system automatically.

changed_at.description: The date and time when the change was made, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2024-12-16T14:30:00.000Z").

created_at.description: The date and time when the history record was created, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2024-12-16T14:30:00.000Z").

updated_at.description: The date and time when the history record was last updated, in ISO 8601 format (e.g., "2024-12-16T14:30:00.000Z").

category_code.description: The catalog category code of the rule at the time of the change (e.g., "tone_of_voice", "faq").

title.description: The rule title at the time of the change (e.g., "No price quotes to leads" or null).

description.description: The rule description at the time of the change (e.g., "How we answer price questions" or null).

topic.description: The topic of the rule at the time of the change (e.g., "reply_to_clients" or null).

load_mode.description: The own load mode of the rule at the time of the change (e.g., "search" or null).

status.description: The rule status after the change (e.g., "active" or null). Null for records written before this field existed.

tier.description: The precedence tier of the rule after the change (e.g., "owner" or null).

entry_point.description: The entry point of the change (e.g., "rules_page" or null).

author_type.description: The author type of the rule after the change (e.g., "owner" or null).

placed_by.description: What chose the topic (e.g., "writer" or null).

reason.description: The reason the staff member gave for the change (e.g., "Confirmed with the owner" or null).

findings.description: The write gate findings of the change (e.g., [{"type": "duplicate", "blocking": false}] or null).

example.content: Always use a friendly and professional tone when communicating with clients
